<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 360" width="500" height="360">
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Circuit Diagram -->
  <!-- Battery on the left: vertical line from (100, 80) to (100, 260) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="80" x2="100" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="190" x2="100" y2="260" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Battery plates at 150-190 -->
  <!-- Long positive plate (top) -->
  <line x1="85" y1="150" x2="115" y2="150" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Short negative plate (bottom) -->
  <line x1="92" y1="170" x2="108" y2="170" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Long positive plate -->
  <line x1="85" y1="190" x2="115" y2="190" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Short negative plate -->
  <line x1="92" y1="210" x2="108" y2="210" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  
  <!-- Battery labels -->
  <text x="65" y="185" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">E</text>
  <text x="128" y="155" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16">12 V</text>

  <!-- Top wire from battery to top-right corner (320, 80) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="80" x2="320" y2="80" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Resistor R on top wire: between x=190 and x=250 at y=80 -->
  <polyline points="190,80 195,72 205,88 215,72 225,88 235,72 245,88 250,80" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="220" y="60" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">R</text>
  <text x="220" y="42" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">2.0 kΩ</text>

  <!-- Voltmeter across R: connected at x=165 and x=275, dropping to y=130 -->
  <line x1="165" y1="80" x2="165" y2="125" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="275" y1="80" x2="275" y2="125" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="165" y1="125" x2="200" y2="125" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="240" y1="125" x2="275" y2="125" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="220" cy="125" r="20" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="220" y="131" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">V</text>

  <!-- Right vertical wire from (320, 80) down to (320, 260) -->
  <line x1="320" y1="80" x2="320" y2="260" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Thermistor T on right wire: between y=150 and y=210 at x=320 -->
  <g transform="translate(320, 180)">
    <rect x="-12" y="-25" width="24" height="50" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Thermistor diagonal line and arrow -->
    <line x1="-12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="-15" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="2,-15 12,-15 12,-5" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <text x="355" y="177" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18">T</text>

  <!-- Bottom wire from (320, 260) to (100, 260) -->
  <line x1="320" y1="260" x2="100" y2="260" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="250" y="325" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 2.1</text>
</svg>
